basic_info.description: Welcome to this beautiful two-story, two-bedroom, two-bath home located in the desirable Sunnyside neighborhood of San Francisco. This spacious residence boasts stunning views of the iconic city skyline, providing a picturesque backdrop from the comfort of your own home. The open floor plan seamlessly connects the living spaces, featuring a bright and inviting family room perfect for relaxation and entertaining. The kitchen is equipped with elegant granite countertops, offering both style and functionality for your culinary needs. Additional highlights include a two-car garage, providing ample parking and storage, and thoughtfully designed living spaces to accommodate your lifestyle. Enjoy the vibrant community and convenient location in this well-maintained Sunnyside gemyour perfect blend of comfort, style, and breathtaking views awaits!
